entries.title: Psalms 136:1
segments: ¶O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:2
segments: O give praise to the God of gods: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:3
segments: O give praise to the Lord of lords: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:4
segments: To him who only does great wonders: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:5
segments: To him who by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:6
segments: To him by whom the earth was stretched out over the waters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:7
segments: To him who made great lights: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:8
segments: The sun to have rule by day: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:9
segments: The moon and the stars to have rule by night: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:10
segments: ¶To him who put to death the first-fruits of Egypt: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:11
segments: And took out Israel from among them: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:12
segments: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:13
segments: To him who made a way through the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:14
segments: And let Israel go through it: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:15
segments: By him Pharaoh and his army were overturned in the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:16
segments: To him who took his people through the waste land: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:17
segments: To him who overcame great kings: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:18
segments: And put noble kings to death: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:19
segments: Sihon, king of the Amorites: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:20
segments: And Og, king of Bashan: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:21
segments: And gave their land to his people for a heritage: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:22
segments: Even a heritage for his servant Israel: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:23
segments: ¶Who kept us in mind when we were in trouble: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:24
segments: And has taken us out of the hands of our haters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:25
segments: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:26
segments: O give praise to the God of heaven: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
